Hydraulics: steady incompressible flow; Darcy–Weisbach (Colebrook–White or Swamee–Jain, laminar 64/Re) or Hazen–Williams; Newton global-gradient (Todini–Pilati, as in EPANET) or Hardy Cross. Fluid properties: built-in correlations or CoolProp 6.6 (MIT licence).

Mamba FMEA follows the 7-step approach: plan the analysis, model the structure, add functions and characteristics, link failure effects – modes – causes into chains, rate S/O/D (or S/F/M for FMEA-MSR) to get the Action Priority, plan and track optimisation actions, then document and approve the results. Rating descriptions are Mamba FMEA's own wording — tailor them in Settings.
